text:
tara: short thread to lock scope for the Enterprise Proofing pilot. Need a compact launch checklist: retention enforcement, signed exports, and a BYOK handshake path. @vik @mohit PTAL.
vik: agree on compact scope. MVP = tenant-level TTLs (30/90/365), signed export manifest (sha256 + signer id), BYOK pointer to KMS arn only. No per-model TTLs.
mohit: infra note: implement daily purge job + tombstones; export pipeline reads tombstones so deletions are provable. Signing key is platform-managed, rotation every 6 months.
legal: export must include chain-of-custody metadata: who requested, who downloaded, and signature algorithm. Also: key rotation events must appear in exports.
vik: acceptance checklist proposal: 1) TTLs enforced and tested for 3 tenants, 2) export generation with signed manifest, 3) BYOK handshake doc + one pilot verification, 4) SOC2 mapping reviewed by legal.
tara: SLO: evidence export ready within 24h for standard requests; large exports go to concierge. Add CSV summary for quick legal review in MVP.
legal: CSV OK for review but final evidence must include signed manifest and full JSONL payload. Add manifest canonicalization rules.
mohit: risk: large exports will be IO heavy. We'll cap export size and provide estimates in UI. If purge fails, alert and pause new writes for that tenant.
ops-bot: automatic message  created ticket EPIC-215555: enterprise-proofing-evidence, owners: vik, mohit, tara.
tara: owners assigned. If no objections by EOD I'll lock scope and start RFC. :thumbsup:
